title: Unbounded proper base change over a torsion coefficient ring
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative torsion ring (equivalently $n\cdot1_\Lambda=0$ for some integer $n\ge1$). Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes, $g:Y'\to Y$ any morphism, $X'=X\times_Y Y'$, and $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$ the projections. Write $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the small etale site and $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for the unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules over the constant coefficient ring, as in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For every $E\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$, the canonical exchange map of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]
$$g^{-1}Rf_*E\longrightarrow Rf'_*g'^{-1}E$$
is an isomorphism in $D(Y'_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$.

source.place: Tag 0F0G, lemma-projection-formula-proper-mod-n, proof; Tag 0F0C, lemma-proper-base-change-mod-n, proof with torsion-ring coefficients

proof.text: Choose $n\geq1$ with $n1_\Lambda=0$ and the ring homomorphism $\varphi:\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z\to\Lambda$, $[a]\mapsto a1_\Lambda$. It is well defined because replacing $a$ by $a+nb$ changes its image by $b(n1_\Lambda)=0$. For a representing complex $C$ of $E$, let $C_n$ be the same complex of abelian sheaves, with $[a]m=(a1_\Lambda)m$. The differentials are $\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$-linear. Kernels, images and cokernels have the same underlying abelian sheaves, so this termwise restriction preserves quasi-isomorphisms and gives $E_n\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Forgetting all coefficients gives literally the same underlying complex, hence $U_X^\Lambda E=U_X^{\mathbf Z/n}E_n$ in the abelian derived category.

source.place: Tag 0F0G, lemma-projection-formula-proper-mod-n, reduction to fibres; Tag 0F0C, lemma-proper-base-change-mod-n, extended to torsion rings by coefficient forgetting

proof.text: Apply [lem-kun-0f0c] to the original cartesian square and $E_n$. Its statement permits every $n\geq1$, every proper $f$, arbitrary $g$, and an unbounded complex of $\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$-module sheaves. Thus $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathbf Z/n}_{\square,E_n}$ is an isomorphism. No invertibility of $n$ on a scheme, no finite coefficient algebra assumption, and no scheme of finite type over a field is required.

source.place: Tag 0F0G, lemma-projection-formula-proper-mod-n, reduction to fibres; Tag 0F0C, lemma-proper-base-change-mod-n, extended to torsion rings by coefficient forgetting

proof.text: Apply [lem-kun-unbounded-abelian-exchange-comparison] first with coefficients $\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$ and complex $E_n$. Its fixed endpoint isomorphisms satisfy $t_n U^{\mathbf Z/n}_{Y'}(\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathbf Z/n}_{\square,E_n})=\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathbf Z}_{\square,U_X^{\mathbf Z/n}E_n}s_n$. The middle forgotten map is invertible by step 2, so the abelian exchange equals $t_n U^{\mathbf Z/n}_{Y'}(\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathbf Z/n}_{\square,E_n})s_n^{-1}$ and is invertible. Now apply the same comparison with coefficients $\Lambda$ and complex $E$. By step 1 its abelian exchange is the very same map. Consequently $U^\Lambda_{Y'}(\operatorname{Ex}^{\Lambda}_{\square,E})=t_\Lambda^{-1}\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathbf Z}_{\square,U_X^\Lambda E}s_\Lambda$ is invertible. These equations identify the actual adjunction mates, rather than just isomorphic endpoint objects.

source.place: Tag 0F0G, lemma-projection-formula-proper-mod-n, reduction to fibres; Tag 0F0C, lemma-proper-base-change-mod-n, extended to torsion rings by coefficient forgetting

proof.text: The functor $U^\Lambda_{Y'}$ reflects isomorphisms by [lem-kun-unbounded-abelian-exchange-comparison]. Apply that assertion to the map whose forgotten image was proved invertible in step 3. The resulting isomorphism is precisely $g^{-1}Rf_*E\to Rf'_*g'^{-1}E$ of the statement.
